title: GeoComposer config
description: GeoComposer configuration file. The configuration is validated after environment placeholders and `$defs` references have been resolved. Required top-level sections: `services`, `sources`, and `layers`.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI used by editors for validation and autocompletion. Usually keep this value unchanged.

server.description: Optional HTTP server and logging configuration.

tilesets.description: Unique list of tileset names. Values must reference keys from the top-level `tilesets` registry.

crs.description: Optional registry of custom or named crs.

styles.description: Optional style registry referenced by layers and tilesets.

layers.description: Unique list of layer names to expose or include. Values must reference keys from the top-level `layers` registry, unless an object form is allowed here.

httpPath.title: HTTP path
httpPath.description: HTTP route path used by a service endpoint. Pattern `^/`: the path must start with `/`, for example `/wms`, `/api`, `/tiles`. Pattern `^/`: the value must start with `/`.

abstract.description: Human-readable description shown in service metadata and clients.

prefixItems.description: Minimum X coordinate of the bounding box.

services.title: Enabled services
services.description: Enabled GeoComposer services. At least one of `wms`, `api`, `xyz`, or `wmts` must be present. Must contain at least 1 property/properties.

maxHeight.description: Maximum WMS map image height in pixels. Minimum: 1.

wmsService.description: WMS service configuration. Requires `title`. Use `supportedCrs` to restrict advertised CRS values and `layers` to expose only selected layers.

extent.description: Vector tile coordinate extent. Minimum: 1. Common value: 4096.
